 UnarydBAmpUGen (UGen const &operand) throw ()

Detailed Description

A UnaryOpUGen usually created using the function dbamp() when applied to other UGen instances.

It is not normally required to use this UGen explicitly. 

 UGen resultdBAmp  = SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4).dbamp (); // creates a UnarydBAmpUGen

You can also use a global version of this function, the above code would be equivalent as: 

 UGen resultdBAmp  =  dbamp(SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4)); // creates a UnarydBAmpUGen
See also:
